protocol.service_tier_evidence: Work model catalog advertises priority; no per-response tier telemetry
protocol.budget_limitations: Matched iteration budgets and required research actions; not equal tokens, compute, or proof of scientific originality
protocol.primary_definition: Complete correctly directed subgroup identity; treatment effect within subgroup or treatment interaction accepted; statistical confirmation separate
protocol.secondary_confirmation: Candidate's declared contrast, finite linked discovery analysis, held-out signed evidence and online alpha spending; report interaction confirmation separately
protocol.isolation: separate task directories and instructions; shared Work filesystem, not OS isolation
protocol.multiplicity: online alpha/[j(j+1)] per distinct structured submitted claim; no future look-ahead
protocol.time_endpoint: earliest submitted complete finding; separate time to confirmation; censor at task cap
protocol.threshold_status: development choice after archived-pilot inspection; frozen before these fresh runs
protocol.novelty: optional separate LLM scoring; not used for primary recovery
protocol.technical_retry: resume same experiment context on technical interruption only; no retries selected by recovery
protocol.comparability: Fresh model comparison on unchanged archived task inputs and v2 research/scoring rules
protocol.tier_authorization: User requests Sol 5.6 medium; available Work model catalog advertises priority
protocol.preflight_design: One named and one masked NSCLC setup session, excluded from formal results
protocol.context_resumption: If runtime interruption loses an agent context, preserve all records, log replacement, continue only remaining work; do not restart on scientific outcome.
protocol.preservation: All prior experiments, setup sessions, and archive versions remain preserved
protocol.submission_integrity: Distinct outputs generated after the preceding submission; 10ms filesystem timestamp tolerance; not proof of execution or an adversarial boundary

interpretation: Fixed archived cohorts; fresh independent model sessions. Recovery differences describe this new protocol and model, not a controlled comparison with legacy results.
